info.name: FINDORA Campus Lost and Found Portal API Test Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman test collection for Sai University Web Technology & Internet Programming Individual Project.
Covers 10+ test scenarios: successful requests, invalid input, item retrieval, search & filter, duplicate match detection, claim submission, claim approval, and unauthorized/forbidden security checks.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Service is online', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.status).to.eql('online'); });
pm.test('Status code is 201 or 409 (if re-run)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 409]); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('authToken', data.token); }
pm.test('Validation rejected with 400 Bad Request', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

pm.test('Login returns 200 and JWT', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('authToken', data.token); });
pm.test('Access denied with 401 without Bearer token', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('Student token blocked with 403 Forbidden on admin endpoint', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: 07. Item Retrieval, Keyword Search & Campus Building Filters

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Returns items array', function () { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.items).to.be.an('array'); });

exec: pm.test('Report created with 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.item._id).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('createdItemId', data.item._id); });

item.name: 09. Single Item Details & Smart Duplicate/Match Calculation

exec: pm.test('Item details returned with 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.item.title).to.include('Dell Precision'); });

pm.test('Claim created or handled correctly', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 400, 409]); if (pm.response.code === 201) { pm.environment.set('createdClaimId', pm.response.json().claim._id); } });

item.name: 11. Admin / Reporter Claim Review & Status Approval

exec: pm.test('Claim status updated', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]); });
pm.test('Status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Metrics include total, claimed, recoveryRate', function () { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.stats).to.have.property('totalItems'); pm.expect(data.stats).to.have.property('recoveryRate'); });
